nodes.label: Launch Screen
nodes.rationale: A launch screen's sole function is to enhance the perception of a quick launch; it is not an artistic, branding, or advertising opportunity.

nodes.label: Splash Screen
nodes.rationale: If needed, show a beautiful graphic that succinctly communicates branding; display it at the beginning of onboarding or right after launching completes.

nodes.label: Progress Indicators
nodes.rationale: Use a determinate progress indicator when the loading duration is known and an indeterminate one when it is not.

nodes.label: Tips
nodes.rationale: Tips work best on features that are easy to describe; keep them short, actionable, and gated by eligibility rules so they reach the intended audience.

nodes.label: Tooltips
nodes.rationale: Limit tooltip content to 60-75 characters, begin with a verb, and avoid repeating the control's name because repetition rarely adds value.

nodes.label: Liquid Glass Clear Variant
nodes.rationale: Clear variant prioritizes visibility of underlying content; over bright content a ~35% dark dimming layer is required to preserve legibility.

nodes.label: Color on Liquid Glass
nodes.rationale: Apply color sparingly; for primary actions prefer coloring the background over the foreground, and only one primary action per context gets background emphasis.

nodes.label: Material Thickness Levels
nodes.rationale: Choose materials based on semantic meaning and recommended usage, not apparent color, because system settings can change a material's appearance.

nodes.label: Liquid Glass
nodes.rationale: File explicitly documents Liquid Glass design rules so the visual pattern can be replicated in any framework (Flutter, Tauri, Electron, React Native) using blur, translucency, and layered composition.

nodes.label: Attribution
nodes.rationale: Attributions express the underlying basis of a result to impart transparency; keep them factual and balance specificity so people can reason about results.

nodes.label: Calibration
nodes.rationale: Use calibration only when the feature cannot function without the initial information; collect only the most essential information and let people cancel at any time.

nodes.label: Confidence
nodes.rationale: Verify that confidence values correspond to result quality before conveying them; avoid showing low-confidence results, especially for proactive features.

nodes.label: Corrections
nodes.rationale: Provide immediate value when people correct a mistake and persist the update; prefer guided corrections over freeform ones.

nodes.label: Explicit Feedback
nodes.rationale: Request explicit feedback only when necessary and always make it voluntary; act immediately and persist the resulting changes to build trust.

nodes.label: Implicit Feedback
nodes.rationale: Always secure implicit feedback information, give people ways to restrict its flow, and prefer recent feedback to match people's changing tastes.

nodes.label: Limitations
nodes.rationale: Set realistic expectations so a limitation does not appear to be a defect; show people how to get the best results and explain why inferior results occur.

nodes.label: Mistakes
nodes.rationale: Anticipate mistakes, help people handle them, and learn from them when the learning improves the app; balance empathy with the seriousness of the consequences.

nodes.label: Multiple Options
nodes.rationale: Prefer diverse options to balance accuracy with choice, list the most likely option first, and avoid overwhelming people with too many options.
